name: typo-fixer
description: Ultra-fast, zero-dependency bilingual typo fixer & accidental keyboard layout converter (Arabic ⇄ English)

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming "[name].mjs" --format esm && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming "[name].cjs" --format cjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run test
